summary: Overcooked entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Overcooked
entries.definitive_edition: Original PC/Gourmet route for the first game; All You Can Eat for remastered collection coverage

emulation.notes: Use native PC or console releases.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC original, or All You Can Eat remaster if preserving the collection route

primary.version: Original Overcooked PC release with DLC/Gourmet Edition content documented
primary.why: The original PC route preserves the first game's unremastered physics, controls, and level presentation while offering clean capture. Overcooked! All You Can Eat is a higher-fidelity remastered package with online play and extra content, but it changes the preservation target and also includes Overcooked 2.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original PC release, ideally with Gourmet Edition/Lost Morsel/Festive Seasoning content available. Record build, DLC installed, controller setup, player count, assist/accessibility settings, stars earned, and whether the All You Can Eat remaster was compared separately.

secondary.platform: Overcooked! All You Can Eat on Windows PC / current consoles
secondary.exclusive_content: Remastered 4K package, online multiplayer, cross-play, extra levels, and Overcooked 2 content
secondary.what_to_play: Use if the archive goal is the modern remastered collection rather than the original 2016 game.
secondary.why: It is the broadest modern package, but it is not the unmodified original first game.

secondary.platform: Nintendo Switch / PlayStation / Xbox original-console releases
secondary.why: PC is cleaner for capture, but console local-co-op context may matter.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC version of the original game with capture flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: preserves original game behavior while supporting clean capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Remastered collection with higher-resolution assets, online play, and extra content.
all_releases.reason: secondary: modern collection route, but not the original-only preservation route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Original PC best preserves the 2016 game; All You Can Eat is more complete and higher fidelity but remasters the first game and includes Overcooked 2.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not treat All You Can Eat as identical to the original 2016 release; log which route was played.
